Punjab Kings’ Arshdeep Singh joins Mumbai Indians in much-anticipated IPL player trade. File | Photo Credit: PTI
Mumbai Indians (MI) released their list of retained and released players on the IPL 2027 retention deadline day ahead of the auction. The five-time champions retained 16 players, entering the mini-auction with a remaining purse of ₹32.60 crore and nine available squad slots (including two overseas slots).
MI re-adjusted their roster through a high-value trade, swapping all-rounder Hardik Pandya to Punjab Kings in exchange for pacer Arshdeep Singh.
MI parted with 13 players with New Zealand pacer Boult and fas bowler Deepak Chahar being the biggest releases. They were bought by MI for Rs. 12.5 crore and Rs. 9.25 respectively in the IPL 2025 mega auction.
Afghanistan spinner AM Ghazanfar, South Africa spinner Keshav Maharaj were also let go.
MI finished ninth in IPL 2026, missing the Playoffs for the fourth time in the last six seasons.
